title: On supersingular isogeny graphs of Drinfeld modules
summary: We study supersingular isogeny graphs of rank-two Drinfeld modules over $A=\mathbb{F}_q[T]$. For distinct finite primes $\mathfrak p$ and $\mathfrak q$ of $A$, we prove that the graph in characteristic $\mathfrak p$, with edges given by cyclic $\mathfrak q$-isogenies, is connected. The proof combines Gekeler's ideal-class correspondence with strong approximation to realize the graph as a quotient of the Bruhat--Tits tree of the homothety classes of $A_\mathfrak q$-lattices in $(\mathbb{F}_q(T))_\mathfrak q^2$.
